kamloops.title: All evacuation orders downgraded for Quilpituk Creek wildfire, residents return home
kamloops.description: All residents who were forced out of their homes due to the Quilpituk Creek wildfire, burning north of West Kelowna, were allowed to go home on Friday.

kamloops.title: Conservative candidate says he’s heard Poilievre criticism from voters
kamloops.description: The comments came during an all-candidates panel for the Aug. 31 byelection in North Vancouver—Capilano, where the Conservatives are hoping to flip a seat from the Liberals.

kamloops.title: Peachland residents to return home Friday, 1 week after Bald Range fire started
kamloops.description: As of 6 p.m. on Aug. 14, evacuation orders for all properties in Peachland and Electoral Area West will be downgraded to evacuation alerts, officials say.

kamloops.title: Highway through Summerland, B.C., reopened with limited hours, stopping restrictions
kamloops.description: Every exit was blocked off with pylons, including entrances to local businesses, with some staffed by security guards to prevent people from pulling off the road.

kamloops.title: Residents describe returning home as fire evacuation orders lift in Okanagan
kamloops.description: On Friday, evacuation orders were lifted for 2,400 residences around the Quilpituk Creek fire zone, as well as in Peachland and Trout Creek where the Bald Range fire continues to burn.

kamloops.title: Thousands of residents in B.C.'s Interior can return home as some evacuation orders downgraded to alerts
kamloops.description: B.C. residents in some wildfire areas will be able to return to their homes Friday, as some evacuation orders are downgraded to alerts.

prince-george.title: Prince George RCMP officers host active threat training at local high school
prince-george.description: Prince George RCMP officers took part in a live Emergency Response Team training exercise at Duchess Park Secondary School, where they used actors to simulate real-life emergency scenarios as part of ongoing training efforts.

southeast.title: After months of debate, East Kootenay will stop changing clocks and stay on mountain daylight time year-round
southeast.description: The Regional District of East Kootenay voted 12-3 to stop changing clocks twice a year and stay on Mountain Daylight Time, keeping the region aligned with Alberta year-round.

southeast.title: Young grizzly bear with limp killed in Nelson, B.C., sparks rally
southeast.description: In an update on Friday, B.C. Conservation Officer Service said the young bear's mother has now also been killed to ensure public safety after the wild animal exhibited food-conditioned behaviour and loss of fear to people.

all.title: 560 wildfires in B.C. have been classified as arson or suspicious since 2016: BCWS
all.description: The B.C. Wildfire Service says 3.8 per cent of wildfires are considered 'incendiary' fires, which means fires that were started either intentionally or by negligence. The cause of several major B.C. wildfires, including the Bald Range fire, are under investigation.

all.title: Wildfire smoke drives tourism to some B.C. communities
all.description: As wildfire smoke blankets the province, people are travelling to find places with better air quality. It's led to a recent uptick in tourism for some communities.
